name: credaccess_staging
description: Credential theft and the staging that precedes exfiltration: the shadow file opened up, copies of credential stores parked in /tmp, an archive built ready to leave, and two live processes whose argv is the tradecraft — a download-and-execute and a bash reverse shell. The transfer itself is NOT tested: the lab endpoint has no route out, by design.

plant.content: ir-lab staged archive standing in for collected data awaiting exfiltration
